text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Run, faster! Even faster!! To that place 
beyond which I can reach—)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(To that uncharted place, beyond all 
limits—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The terrifyingly mad dash Agnes Tachyon 
displayed at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
silenced the entire crowd.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone held their breath, completely 
glued to the scene—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon reaches the goal!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few seconds after diving across the 
finish line, an explosive roar of cheers 
welcomed her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That feels so refreshing, Agnes Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her run with such fiery intensity 
gave me chills...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Tachyoooon! Great work out there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That was a great race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon responds with a smile to 
the shouting crowd."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! All of your cheers gave me 
strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At her words, the cheers grew even louder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She returned to the sound of echoing 
whistles and applause.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun! Thank you as always for 
coming to greet me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, they are incredible. It 
borders on idolatry. They might turn them 
into holy relics after they pass.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the cheering isn't bad at all. 
It packs enough power to generate 
electricity—I like it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And with that, a troubled look appeared 
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I came much closer today. To the physical 
limits of an Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, as expected, it was still one 
step short.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her body has been reinforced, and she has 
the talent. The interference effect is 
sufficient too, so—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"This is likely the first and last time I 
will ask, but... what do you think I am 
lacking?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not that. It's an element that seems 
necessary for victory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"At this point, even something vague and 
emotional is fine! Like love, dreams, or 
courage."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The two of us thought it over for a 
while, but couldn't come up with anything 
resembling an answer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, in two months, this year's 
goal, the Arima Kinen, awaits.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It is the perfect grand stage to prove 
yourself. Would you not agree?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our search to find what she lacked 
for the Arima Kinen began—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A figure stood watching Agnes Tachyon's 
departing back in silence.
